archetypes.typography_specs: Prompt text: text-lg font-semibold. Drawer title: text-2xl font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Drawer trigger button, accessible slide-over sheet component (`BottomSheet` / `ModalDialog`).
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Drawer opens fullscreen on mobile devices.
archetypes.accessibility: Focus trapped inside sheet, Escape key dismisses, aria-modal='true'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Ensure drawer backdrop is dark enough (50% scrim) to maintain text focus.

archetypes.name: High-Impact Contrast Card Band
archetypes.best_for: General agencies and SaaS landing pages with a clear primary conversion goal.
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered rounded card (`rounded-3xl p-12 sm:p-16`) with high-contrast background (dark on light site, or primary gradient on dark site), bold H2, subtitle, and dual CTA buttons.
archetypes.typography_specs: H2: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold text-white tracking-tight. Subhead: text-lg text-slate-300.
archetypes.key_components: High-contrast container, primary action button, secondary ghost button, confidence guarantee tag ('No credit card required').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Paddings reduce to p-8 on mobile; buttons stack full width.
archetypes.accessibility: Ensures min 7:1 contrast ratio between text and card background.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No purple radioactive gradient glows; use deep grounded slate or accessible navy.

archetypes.name: Embedded Interactive Calendar Scheduler
archetypes.best_for: Agencies where booking a 30-minute discovery call is the sole metric of success.
archetypes.layout_structure: Left column explains what happens on the call (Agenda, Who you will meet, Deliverables); Right column embeds an inline Cal.com / Calendly booking widget.
archetypes.typography_specs: Agenda items: text-sm font-semibold. Call duration badge: text-xs font-mono.
archetypes.key_components: Agenda bullet list, host avatar & bio, responsive iframe/widget container with loading state.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with booking widget on bottom; embedded widget/iframe must auto-resize height on mobile (never lock to a rigid desktop pixel height that clips the submit button or forces nested scrollbars) and keep <select> labels concise so options never truncate.
archetypes.accessibility: Iframe has descriptive title='Book a discovery call on Cal.com'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Do not embed broken widgets without a direct link fallback; never simulate fake 'Confirmation sent' emails or hardcoded .ics timestamps—either wire a real Cal.com/Calendly embed or API, or label local demo mode clearly and compute dynamic .ics dates/times.

archetypes.name: Inline Instant Lead Capture Form
archetypes.best_for: SEO, PPC, and CRO agencies offering a free automated audit or quote.
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered banner with bold headline ('Get your free 14-point audit in 24 hours') + clean 2-field form (Website URL + Email) with submit CTA.
archetypes.typography_specs: Input text: text-base. Button text: text-base font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Form fields with floating labels, honeypot spam protection, submission status spinner.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Inline desktop layout; stacked inputs and button on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Visible labels, aria-live status announcement on submit.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Never ask for phone numbers or company size in a final instant capture form.

archetypes.name: Interactive Contact Form with Budget Pills
archetypes.best_for: High-ticket agencies that need to qualify client budgets before accepting calls.
archetypes.layout_structure: Clean card with multi-choice budget pills ('$5k-$10k', '$10k-$25k', '$25k+') + service checkboxes + message field.
archetypes.typography_specs: Pill text: text-xs font-mono font-semibold. Section labels: text-sm font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Custom toggle pills (`role='radio'`), accessible text inputs, privacy reassurance tag.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Budget pills wrap neatly in 2 columns on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: role='radiogroup' for budget selection; keyboard arrow navigation.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Keep form steps under 4 questions to prevent abandonment.

archetypes.name: Founder Personal Letter & Direct Phone/Email
archetypes.best_for: Elite boutique studios and high-trust consultants pitching senior executives.
archetypes.layout_structure: Personal invitation card: Founder headshot, direct phone number, personal direct email, and promise: 'I reply to every email personally within 4 hours'.
archetypes.typography_specs: Letter text: text-lg font-serif leading-relaxed. Founder name: text-base font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Authentic candid portrait, direct mailto/tel links, copyable email button.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Centered stack on mobile viewports.
archetypes.accessibility: Clear tel and mailto links with aria-labels.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No generic contact@ or info@ addresses; use real person's email.

archetypes.name: Dual-Path Split CTA (Startups vs Enterprise)
archetypes.best_for: Agencies or SaaS catering to two completely different customer tiers.
archetypes.layout_structure: Side-by-side 2-column card: Left side 'For Early-Stage Startups' (Self-serve / Fast kickoff); Right side 'For Enterprise Teams' (Custom security / Talk to VP).
archetypes.typography_specs: Path title: text-2xl font-bold. Description: text-sm.
archetypes.key_components: Two distinct CTA buttons with specific routing, separate feature bullet points.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks into two distinct sequential cards on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Distinct heading levels (H3) and clear button labels for each path.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Make visual weight equal or intentionally elevate the higher-value path.

archetypes.name: Multi-Column Sitemap Hub (Standard Corporate)
archetypes.best_for: Standard agencies with rich sitemaps, services, resources, and legal pages.
archetypes.layout_structure: 4 or 5-column grid: Column 1 brand logo & mission summary; Columns 2-4 category link columns; Column 5 newsletter / social links.
archetypes.typography_specs: Column headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Links: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] hover:text-white.
archetypes.key_components: Brand logo, social icon strip (SVG), category columns, bottom copyright and legal bar (Privacy, Terms, Cookies).
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Collapses to 2-column on tablet, single accordion or stacked list on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: role='contentinfo', link lists wrapped in <ul>, valid focus states.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No broken placeholder links; all links must resolve.

archetypes.name: Editorial Giant Typography Footer
archetypes.best_for: Awwwards-style creative design studios and luxury brands.
archetypes.layout_structure: Top tier simple link row; Bottom tier dominated by a massive full-width agency name in 12vw typography stretching across the viewport.
archetypes.typography_specs: Giant wordmark: text-[12vw] font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none text-[var(--border-subtle)].
archetypes.key_components: Massive SVG or font wordmark, time zone clocks ('London 14:32 • New York 09:32'), minimal legal row.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Viewport-width typography (`12vw`) scales smoothly without horizontal overflow.
archetypes.accessibility: Giant wordmark marked aria-hidden='true' if redundant to brand text. Every footer and social link must maintain >= 24x24px hit area (WCAG 2.5.8; >= 44px on touch) via padding/min-block-size—never let short links like 'X' shrink below 24px.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Ensure overflow-hidden on container to prevent horizontal scrollbar bugs.

archetypes.name: Newsletter-First Content Hub
archetypes.best_for: Agencies with active thought leadership, research reports, or newsletters.
archetypes.layout_structure: Top prominent newsletter card ('Join 15,000 marketing leaders receiving our weekly teardown') with inline email form + standard link grid below.
archetypes.typography_specs: Newsletter title: text-xl font-bold. Form button: text-sm font-semibold.
archetypes.key_components: Email input field, subscribe button, anti-spam reassurance, subscriber count badge.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Newsletter input stacks above button on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Explicit label for email input, aria-live error/success message.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No annoying pop-ups; keep the newsletter anchored gracefully in the footer.

archetypes.name: Minimalist Single-Line Strip
archetypes.best_for: Single-page landing pages, personal portfolios, minimal micro-sites.
archetypes.layout_structure: A single clean horizontal row (`h-16 border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] px-6 flex items-center justify-between`): Logo left, Copyright center, Social links right.
archetypes.typography_specs: Text: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]. Social icons: 18x18 SVG.
archetypes.key_components: Logo mark, copyright text, minimal social icon links.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks into centered vertical column on mobile with 8px spacing.
archetypes.accessibility: Full keyboard accessibility on all social icon links with aria-labels.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Do not omit mandatory legal links (Privacy Policy) if collecting data.

archetypes.name: Multi-Office Global Footprint
archetypes.best_for: International agencies with offices across multiple cities (e.g. New York, London, Tokyo).
archetypes.layout_structure: Grid of office location cards; each card features city name, local live time clock, physical address, and local phone number.
archetypes.typography_specs: City name: text-lg font-bold. Time clock: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-500.
archetypes.key_components: Live JavaScript time clock per city, Google Maps link, local phone number.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Live clocks update without triggering disruptive screen reader announcements.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Ensure phone numbers use international dial codes (+1, +44).

archetypes.name: App Download & Ecosystem Matrix
archetypes.best_for: Agencies with proprietary software, mobile apps, or extensive partner integrations.
archetypes.layout_structure: Top tier App Store & Google Play badge buttons + QR code for instant phone scan; Bottom tier standard legal and platform status link.
archetypes.typography_specs: Badge subtext: text-[10px]. Badge title: text-xs font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: App Store SVG badge, Google Play SVG badge, QR code frame with scan tooltip, system status badge ('All systems normal').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: QR code hides on mobile viewports; direct app store buttons take full width.
archetypes.accessibility: Badges have descriptive aria-labels ('Download on Apple App Store').
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Use official brand SVG assets for store badges; no distorted PNGs.

archetypes.name: Centered Toggle Hero with Trial Chip
archetypes.best_for: SaaS products offering self-serve monthly and annual plans with a discount incentive.
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered max-w-4xl mx-auto py-20 text-center flex flex-col items-center. Category eyebrow chip, punchy H1, subtitle, followed by an accessible segmented control pill toggle (Monthly / Annual [Save 20%]).
archetypes.typography_specs: H1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight. Pill text: text-sm font-semibold. Discount badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-600 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full.
archetypes.key_components: Category chip, massive H1, subhead, segmented pill button toggle with active sliding indicator, 14-day trial badge.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stays centered; pill toggle remains full-width or auto-centered with 44px min tap target.
archetypes.accessibility: Segmented switch uses role='radiogroup' or aria-pressed='true' on the selected billing interval.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No shouting fake urgency timers ('Offer ends in 3 mins!'); keep discount pill tasteful and quiet.

archetypes.name: Split Value-Proof Hero with ROI Calculator Trigger
archetypes.best_for: B2B and enterprise solutions where price requires immediate ROI justification and payback-period evidence.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 items-center py-20). Left (7 cols): High-impact value proposition, guaranteed ROI statement. Right (5 cols): Compact interactive payback estimator widget.
archetypes.typography_specs: H1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight. Metric callouts: text-3xl font-mono font-extrabold text-[var(--primary)].
archetypes.key_components: Value headline, 3-bullet ROI guarantee list, interactive slider widget estimating monthly hours/dollars saved.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with headline on top and calculator card below.
archetypes.accessibility: Slider input has aria-label='Team size slider' with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: ROI estimates must state standard methodology assumptions; no arbitrary 10,000% claims.

archetypes.name: Usage-Based Seat Estimator Hero
archetypes.best_for: Developer infrastructure, API platforms, and usage-based products where pricing scales with volume or seats.
archetypes.layout_structure: Single column max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center py-16. Interactive logarithmic scale slider directly under the headline dynamically updating tier recommendation in real time.
archetypes.typography_specs: Slider readout: text-4xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Sub-label: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)].
archetypes.key_components: Logarithmic range input, current value badge, recommended tier indicator, dynamic price preview.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Full width slider track with oversized 28px draggable thumb for touch friendliness.
archetypes.accessibility: Keyboard arrow keys increment/decrement slider; aria-valuetext announces estimated tier.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No jumping layout heights during value scrub; fixed dimension value container.

archetypes.name: Sticky Header Grouped Category Matrix
archetypes.best_for: Products with 20+ features categorized across Core, Security, Integrations, and Support tiers.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width table with sticky top row containing plan names and mini-CTAs on window scroll. Rows grouped by category headers (collapsible). Cells display checkmarks, dashes, or specific numeric limits.
archetypes.typography_specs: Category headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Feature names: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]. Tier headers: text-base font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Sticky thead, info tooltip triggers on technical terms, category accordion headers, SVG check / minus icons, plan CTA buttons.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Horizontal swipe container on mobile with sticky first column (feature name) and scroll indicators.
archetypes.accessibility: th scope='col' on plan names, th scope='row' on feature names, tooltips accessible via keyboard focus and Esc to close.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Do not use low-contrast grey checks against light backgrounds; use high-contrast primary or emerald checkmarks.

archetypes.name: Tabbed Category Feature Matrix
archetypes.best_for: SaaS platforms wanting to prevent 100-row endless scroll fatigue by partitioning features into switchable tabs.
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16. Top tab bar ('Platform Core', 'Security & Compliance', 'Analytics', 'APIs & Developer'). Selecting a tab swaps the active 8-12 row comparison table with zero page jump.
archetypes.typography_specs: Tab labels: text-sm font-semibold. Table headers: text-base font-bold. Row cells: text-sm.
archetypes.key_components: Segmented tab control, animated tab indicator, clean 4-column matrix, feature description tooltips.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Tabs convert to horizontal scroll list on mobile with snap-x scrolling.
archetypes.accessibility: role='tablist' with role='tab' and aria-selected state; keyboard ArrowLeft / ArrowRight navigation.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Tab transitions must use opacity only (duration-150); never use bouncy layout-shifting animations.

archetypes.name: Differentiator-Only Delta Table
archetypes.best_for: High-velocity sales where prospects just want to know 'what do I get if I pay for Pro instead of Starter?'
archetypes.layout_structure: Compact table showing only the 8-10 features that differ between tiers, with a toggle button: 'Show all 45 features'.
archetypes.typography_specs: Header: text-lg font-bold. Delta rows: text-sm font-medium. Toggle button: text-xs font-mono underline.
archetypes.key_components: 'Show differences only' switch, clean delta rows, expandable drawer for complete baseline specs.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Clean 3-column card comparison on mobile without horizontal scrolling.
archetypes.accessibility: Expand button has aria-expanded='false' and aria-controls='full-feature-table'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Clearly state that baseline features are included in higher tiers so users are not confused.

archetypes.name: 2-Column Selectable Add-on Card Grid
archetypes.best_for: Products with specialized upgrades (Dedicated IP, Custom Onboarding, SOC2 Report, Extra Storage).
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 max-w-5xl mx-auto py-12). Each card features checkbox/switch, addon title, description, and '+ $X/mo' badge.
archetypes.typography_specs: Addon title: text-base font-semibold. Price tag: text-sm font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)]. Description: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Custom accessible checkbox, price badge, title, 2-line explanation, optional tooltip.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Single column stack on mobile with full-width tap target cards.
archetypes.accessibility: role='checkbox' with aria-checked, keyboard Space to toggle, card click delegates to input.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No pre-checking optional add-ons as sneaky dark patterns; all add-ons default to unchecked.

archetypes.name: Horizontal Add-on Strip with Live Cart Subtotal
archetypes.best_for: E-commerce or developer API tools with quick one-click provision extras.
archetypes.layout_structure: Stacked horizontal strip rows separated by 1px borders. Left: Icon + title. Center: pricing metric. Right: '+ Add' button that changes to checked state.
archetypes.typography_specs: Title: text-sm font-medium. Price: text-sm font-mono. Button: text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5.
archetypes.key_components: Icon, descriptor, unit price, actionable stateful toggle button, bottom sticky subtotal readout.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Wraps price and button cleanly on mobile without line truncation.
archetypes.accessibility: Buttons have clear aria-label='Add Dedicated Support to subscription for $150 per month'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Explicit price per billing cycle; never hide whether addon is monthly or annual.

archetypes.name: Full-Width High-Trust Procurement Card
archetypes.best_for: Enterprise procurement teams requiring SOC2, HIPAA, custom MSAs, 99.99% uptime, and vendor diligence.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width elevated card (max-w-6xl mx-auto py-12 px-8 sm:px-12 rounded-3xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)]). Left 2/3: Enterprise capability matrix (SAML SSO, SCIM, Dedicated CSM, Custom Legal MSA). Right 1/3: 'Contact Enterprise Sales' primary action card with guaranteed response time.
archetypes.typography_specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold. Checklist: text-sm font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Security certification badges (SOC2, HIPAA, ISO27001, GDPR), 4-item compliance checklist, 'Talk to Enterprise Sales' CTA button, response time guarantee chip ('< 2 hr response').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks into single column on mobile with CTA pinned below the checklist.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic list <ul> with SVG checkmarks having aria-hidden='true', CTA button has descriptive focus ring.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No generic 'Enterprise-grade' marketing buzzwords without citing actual verified protocols (e.g. specify SAML 2.0 / Okta / Azure AD).

archetypes.name: Split RFQ Direct Procurement Form
archetypes.best_for: Companies with high contract values ($20k+/yr) where instant quoting is replaced with custom scoping.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column container. Left: Executive trust bullets and customer logos. Right: 4-field enterprise qualification form (Work email, Company size, Deployment timeline, Primary requirement).
archetypes.typography_specs: Form labels: text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Form inputs: text-sm py-2.5 px-3.5.
archetypes.key_components: Work email validator, company size dropdown, timeline selector, single submit button with loading state.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Full width form fields on mobile; labels remain top-aligned.
archetypes.accessibility: Inputs paired with explicit <label for='...'> tags, aria-required='true', aria-invalid error state messaging.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Never ask for phone numbers on step 1 unless strictly necessary; keep form friction low (max 4 fields).

archetypes.name: 3-Badge Security & Money-Back Strip
archetypes.best_for: Overcoming final purchase anxiety before checkout across both consumer and B2B SaaS.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width subtle container py-8 border-y border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--surface-subtle)]. 3-column layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 text-center).
archetypes.typography_specs: Badge title: text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Sub-text: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Shield SVG icon (30-day money-back guarantee), Lock SVG icon (256-bit SSL encrypted checkout), Refresh SVG icon (Cancel or downgrade anytime with 1 click).
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks into 3 centered items on mobile with 16px vertical gap.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic section with aria-label='Security and Guarantee Commitments'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No fake green padlock clipart or unverified security badges; clean monochromatic outline SVG icons only.

archetypes.name: Floating Sticky Mobile Checkout Drawer
archetypes.best_for: Mobile optimization for complex pricing pages where user scrolls far past the pricing cards.
archetypes.layout_structure: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (sm:hidden) z-40 bg-[var(--surface)]/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-[var(--border-subtle)] px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between shadow-2xl.
archetypes.typography_specs: Selected plan: text-xs font-semibold. Price: text-base font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Button: text-sm font-semibold.
archetypes.key_components: Plan name summary, price/billing interval text, compact 'Choose Plan' CTA button.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Hidden on desktop (sm:hidden), visible and fixed to viewport bottom on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Doesn't block content navigation; dismissible or scrolls quietly into view after passing tier section.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Do not cover more than 68px of screen height; respect bottom safe-area-inset.

archetypes.name: Vertical Alternating Milestone Spine
archetypes.keywords: timeline, milestones, company-history, journey, origin-story, vertical-timeline
archetypes.best_for: Established companies or agencies with 4-8 chronological milestones (Founding, Seed, Series A, Global Expansion).
archetypes.layout_structure: Central vertical spine (1px subtle border) with alternating cards on left and right (desktop). Each node features a glowing year pill, milestone headline, 2-line description, and metric badge.
archetypes.typography_specs: Year badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)] bg-primary/10 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full. Milestone title: text-lg font-bold. Body: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Vertical SVG connecting line, milestone node dots, year badge, event title, optional press/metric tag.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Collapses to single-sided timeline on mobile: vertical line aligns to left margin (pl-8), all cards align right.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic ordered list <ol>, each milestone is an <li> with an aria-label indicating date and milestone.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No pulsating cartoon dots; use subtle border highlights and clean monospaced year typography.

archetypes.name: Horizontal Snapping Milestone Carousel
archetypes.best_for: Fast-moving tech startups wanting a punchy, interactive chronology without vertical page bloat.
archetypes.layout_structure: Horizontal scroll container with snap-x alignment. Progress line connecting chronological nodes horizontally. Navigation arrow triggers with progress bar indicator.
archetypes.typography_specs: Year: text-2xl font-mono font-extrabold text-[var(--primary)]. Headline: text-base font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed.
archetypes.key_components: Horizontal track, active stage indicator, prev/next buttons, stage cards with consistent 320px width.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Smooth touch-swipe horizontal scroll on mobile with pagination dots.
archetypes.accessibility: Scrollable region marked with role='region' and aria-label='Company Timeline Carousel'; keyboard arrows navigate items.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Ensure cards do not truncate text on small screens; enforce minimum readable height.

archetypes.name: Minimalist Year-by-Year Editorial Ledger
archetypes.best_for: Design studios, venture studios, and architecture firms wanting clean, sophisticated typography without graphics.
archetypes.layout_structure: Clean stacked list with 1px top/bottom border dividers. Left col: Year (text-mono). Center col: Milestone headline and narrative. Right col: Key stat or partner logo.
archetypes.typography_specs: Year: text-sm font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]. Headline: text-xl font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)]. Summary: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: 3-column grid row, hover highlight, subtle border separators, monospaced timestamp.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks to 2-column or single column on mobile with year above headline.
archetypes.accessibility: Uses <dl>, <dt> (Year), and <dd> (Description) for accessible definition list semantics.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Zero floating badges or emoji decorations; pure typographic craft and strict alignment.

archetypes.name: 6-Card Numbered Principle Grid
archetypes.best_for: Agencies and tech companies with 4 to 6 clear internal philosophies guiding their work.
archetypes.layout_structure: 3x2 grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Each card: oversized monospaced number (01, 02, ...), bold belief title, 3-sentence operational explanation.
archetypes.typography_specs: Number: text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)]. Title: text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Card surface, monospaced index, title, operational rationale, subtle bottom accent line on hover.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop with stretch alignment.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <section> with <h3> for each principle title; contrast ratio exceeds 7:1.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No cliché stock buzzwords ('We innovate with synergy'); principles must describe actual trade-offs and behaviors.

archetypes.name: Split Manifesto & Belief Accordion
archetypes.best_for: Mission-driven companies where the founders' point of view is the primary differentiator.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column container. Left (5 cols): Sticky founder manifesto statement in large editorial serif font. Right (7 cols): Expandable accordion detailing how each belief is executed.
archetypes.typography_specs: Manifesto: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium leading-relaxed. Accordion title: text-lg font-semibold. Body: text-sm leading-relaxed.
archetypes.key_components: Sticky manifesto column, accessible accordion rows, plus/minus indicator, quote attribution.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with manifesto statement on top.
archetypes.accessibility: <button aria-expanded='false'> on accordion headers with keyboard navigation support.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No glowing purple gradient text in the manifesto; maintain clean dark-mode or high-contrast editorial look.

archetypes.name: Asymmetric Bento Grid of Cultural Pillars
archetypes.best_for: Modern tech brands, creative agencies, and AI companies seeking a visually striking, non-traditional layout.
archetypes.layout_structure: 4-card bento grid (2 large span-2 cards + 2 compact cards). Cards mix typography, code/terminal snippets, and concrete behavioral rules.
archetypes.typography_specs: Pillar title: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-bold. Code snippet: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400 bg-slate-900 p-4 rounded-xl.
archetypes.key_components: Asymmetric grid cells, ambient card borders, code snippet element, metric anchor badge.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Converts to single-column stacked cards on mobile with consistent 16px gap.
archetypes.accessibility: Cards have role='region' or <article> with clear heading hierarchy.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Bento cards must contain actual substance, not empty decorative gradient filler.

archetypes.name: Curated Multi-Aspect Studio Collage
archetypes.best_for: Companies with high-quality authentic workplace, studio, or offsite photography.
archetypes.layout_structure: Asymmetric 5-image collage grid (grid-cols-12 gap-6). Mix of aspect-video hero photo (span-7), vertical portrait (span-5), and bottom panoramic strip.
archetypes.typography_specs: Photo caption: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]. Location badge: text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur rounded.
archetypes.key_components: Aspect-ratio locked image containers, subtle hover zoom (scale-102 duration-300), location tags, caption overlays.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Converts to 2-column or swipeable photo strip on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Every has descriptive alt text describing the team context and physical environment.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: STRICT: Zero generic stock photography (e.g. models in suits high-fiving in glass meeting rooms). Real workplace only.

archetypes.name: Global Hubs & Distributed Footprint Map
archetypes.best_for: Distributed or multi-city agencies and tech platforms with offices in New York, London, Tokyo, etc.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width dark container with stylized SVG world map graphic. Interactive or pinned hub markers (San Francisco, London, Singapore) displaying local team headcount and local time.
archetypes.typography_specs: City name: text-base font-bold. Local time & headcount: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: SVG vector map, pulsing location pins, city card popovers, remote-first manifesto pill.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Map scrolls horizontally or simplifies into a 3-column city card grid on mobile viewports.
archetypes.accessibility: City list also provided in an accessible semantic <ul> hidden visually or beneath the map for screen readers.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Map pins must be accurate and vector-clean; no pixelated map textures.

archetypes.name: Employee Voice & Working Norms Strip
archetypes.best_for: Culture-first companies wanting to highlight how team members actually work and collaborate.
archetypes.layout_structure: 3-column card grid. Each card combines a natural photo of a team member in their setup, a direct quote about working norms, and their role.
archetypes.typography_specs: Quote: text-base italic leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-primary)]. Role: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--primary)].
archetypes.key_components: Authentic portrait, quote text, role label, working style badge (e.g., 'Async / Deep Work Focus').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column on mobile, 3 columns desktop with stretch card heights.
archetypes.accessibility: Quotes wrapped in <figure> and <blockquote> with <figcaption> for attribution.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No manufactured corporate praise; focus on practical working realities.

archetypes.name: C-Suite Grid with Alumni Credibility Badges
archetypes.keywords: leadership, executive-team, c-suite, founders, pedigree, alumni-badges
archetypes.best_for: High-growth tech startups and top-tier consultancies where leadership background drives enterprise trust.
archetypes.layout_structure: 4-column grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-8). Each profile: crisp headshot, executive name, title, and mini previous experience pill strip ('Ex-Stripe', 'Ex-Google', 'MIT').
archetypes.typography_specs: Name: text-lg font-bold. Title: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--primary)]. Alumni pill: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
archetypes.key_components: Headshot (aspect-[4/5] rounded-2xl), name, title, previous company logos/chips, LinkedIn SVG link.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Headshot alt text includes full name and title; LinkedIn link has accessible aria-label.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Consistent portrait lighting and aspect ratios across all photos; no mismatched crops.

archetypes.name: Backed-By Venture Capital & Advisory Board Strip
archetypes.best_for: Venture-backed companies where investor tier-1 brand backing establishes institutional stability.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width section with 2-tier layout: Top tier displays Tier-1 VC investor logos (e.g. Sequoia, Accel, YC); Bottom tier displays 4 advisory board quotes.
archetypes.typography_specs: Section eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--text-muted)]. Quote: text-sm font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Monochrome investor logo row, advisor headshots, quote bubbles, partner credentials.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Logos wrap into 2-3 columns on mobile; advisor quotes stack cleanly.
archetypes.accessibility: Logo SVGs have title attributes; advisor cards use semantic figure/blockquote.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: All logos normalized to uniform greyscale height; no full-color competing sponsor banners.

archetypes.name: Node-Based Data Pipeline Diagram
archetypes.keywords: architecture, data-pipeline, node-graph, technical-diagram, system-flow, engineering
archetypes.best_for: Engineering consultancies, cloud infrastructure, AI/ML pipelines, and data platforms.
archetypes.layout_structure: Interactive SVG flowchart container (min-h-[400px] rounded-2xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] p-8). 3-stage visual nodes (Ingestion -> Processing -> Output/APIs) connected by animated directional paths.
archetypes.typography_specs: Node title: text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)]. Metric badge: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400. Subtitle: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: SVG vector nodes, dashed bezier connecting lines, protocol labels (gRPC, Kafka, REST), inspect drawer on click.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Horizontal scroll with pan-zoom controls on tablet/mobile, or stacks into 3 linear stages.
archetypes.accessibility: SVG has role='img' and aria-label; full text alternative provided in accessible <ul> for screen readers.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No fake 3D isometric clipart; clean 2D engineering blueprint styling with crisp 1px borders.

archetypes.name: Layered Modern Stack Diagram
archetypes.best_for: Enterprise SaaS, cybersecurity, and full-stack software development services.
archetypes.layout_structure: Vertical stack of 4 horizontal layers: Presentation Layer, Core Logic / API Layer, Data & Storage Layer, Security & Observability Layer. Each layer expands to reveal technical specifications.
archetypes.typography_specs: Layer label: text-sm font-mono font-bold uppercase text-[var(--text-primary)]. Technology pills: text-xs font-mono bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 px-2 py-1 rounded.
archetypes.key_components: Collapsible layer bands, security badge callouts, compliance seals, expandable spec panel.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Layers stack vertically on all devices with 100% width.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <section> with <button aria-expanded> for layer details.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No glowing purple gradient borders; maintain structured enterprise blueprint aesthetics.

archetypes.name: Split Methodology & Deliverable Workflow
archetypes.best_for: Agencies and consultancies that pride themselves on rigorous project governance and risk mitigation.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 py-16). Left (5 cols): 4-phase sequential methodology (Discovery, Architecture, Sprint Build, QA & Handover). Right (7 cols): Dynamic card updating to show tangible deliverables per phase.
archetypes.typography_specs: Phase number: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)]. Title: text-xl font-bold. Deliverable item: text-sm font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Phase progress indicator, active phase tab, deliverable asset list, client involvement estimate badge.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Converts to 4 stacked accordion items on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: role='tablist' with role='tab' and aria-controls for the deliverable preview panel.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Clearly state actual technical artifacts, not vague promises like 'synergistic transformation'.

archetypes.name: Categorized Scope & Artifact Accordion
archetypes.best_for: Product studios and software shops detailing exact handover artifacts (Design tokens, Figma system, Clean CI/CD, Documentation).
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered max-w-4xl mx-auto py-12 space-y-4. Stack of 4 broad categories (Design System, Backend Architecture, Quality Assurance, DevOps & Infrastructure), each opening to a checklist of exact deliverables.
archetypes.typography_specs: Category title: text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Deliverable name: text-sm font-medium. Format pill: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
archetypes.key_components: Accordion trigger, artifact count chip ('8 artifacts'), checkmark list, export format tags (.tsx, .fig, .tf).
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Full width on mobile with touch-friendly 48px trigger height.
archetypes.accessibility: Standard accordion pattern with aria-expanded and keyboard Space/Enter toggle.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Specify file formats and licensing; no vague lists of 'good designs'.

archetypes.name: High-Density SLA & Turnaround Table
archetypes.best_for: Managed service providers, retainer agencies, and dev shops with strict delivery commitments.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width table with 5 columns: Service Component, Typical Turnaround, Weekly Dev Allocation, Included Revisions, Testing Coverage Guarantee.
archetypes.typography_specs: Table header: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Cell text: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)].
archetypes.key_components: Semantic <table>, SLA guarantee pill, revision policy badge, coverage badge (>90% unit test).
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Horizontal swipe container on mobile with sticky first column.
archetypes.accessibility: Proper th scope='col' and scope='row' markup; contrast ratio exceeds 4.5:1.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: SLA numbers must be defensible and clear; no ambiguous 'unlimited everything'.

archetypes.name: Interactive Scope Configurator
archetypes.best_for: Modern agency websites allowing prospects to select their exact needs before requesting a proposal.
archetypes.layout_structure: Interactive 3-column selection matrix. Prospects toggle required modules (e.g., Auth & RBAC, Stripe Billing, Realtime WebSockets, Admin Dashboard) and view an estimated delivery timeline.
archetypes.typography_specs: Module title: text-base font-semibold. Timeline readout: text-3xl font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)].
archetypes.key_components: Selectable module cards with checkboxes, estimated timeline meter, 'Generate Scope Brief' CTA button.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column on mobile with sticky bottom timeline readout.
archetypes.accessibility: role='checkbox' with aria-checked states; keyboard toggle.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Estimates must state they are preliminary pending discovery; no misleading auto-commitments.

archetypes.name: Categorized Monochromatic Tech Stack Grid
archetypes.keywords: tech-stack, frameworks, tools, languages, cloud-providers, monochromatic-icons
archetypes.best_for: Developer-focused dev shops and SaaS software agencies where technical stack choices dictate vendor suitability.
archetypes.layout_structure: 4-column category grid: Frontend & Mobile (Next.js, React, React Native), Backend & APIs (Node, Go, Python, GraphQL), Databases & Caching (PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse), Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS, Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes).
archetypes.typography_specs: Category title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Tech name: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Subtle card containers, 24x24 SVG technology icons, version compatibility notes, category headers.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Each tech item has descriptive text (never just an unlabelled icon).
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: All technology logos must be normalized to clean monochromatic SVGs; no chaotic multi-color logo circus.

archetypes.name: Certified Partner Ecosystem Strip
archetypes.best_for: Agencies holding official cloud and software partner credentials (AWS Advanced Partner, Vercel Partner, Stripe Expert).
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered horizontal card strip with 4 high-trust partner cards. Each card displays official partner badge, certified engineer headcount, and direct credential verification link.
archetypes.typography_specs: Partner title: text-base font-bold. Certified count: text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400.
archetypes.key_components: Official vector partner badge, certification badge, certified engineer count, external credential link.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 2x2 grid on mobile, 4-column row on desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: External links have aria-label='Verify AWS Partnership credential (opens in new tab)'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Only show legitimate, verifiable partner credentials; no self-made fake gold awards.

archetypes.name: Searchable Filterable Integration Playground
archetypes.best_for: Enterprise integrations, iPaaS, and software platforms supporting 30+ integrations.
archetypes.layout_structure: Filter pill bar (All, CRM, Payments, Data, Cloud) + live search input. Below: 6x4 compact icon grid updating instantly on filter/search without page reload.
archetypes.typography_specs: Search input: text-sm font-medium. Pill text: text-xs font-semibold. Tech title: text-xs font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Search input, category pills, compact technology badge cards, zero-results fallback state.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Horizontal scroll for category pills on mobile; 3-column grid for tech cards.
archetypes.accessibility: Search input has explicit aria-label='Filter supported integrations'; results announce count.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Fast client-side filtering with zero layout jump; empty state has helpful contact CTA.

archetypes.name: Industry Tabbed Solution Switcher
archetypes.best_for: Companies catering to multiple regulated industries with distinct compliance and functional needs.
archetypes.layout_structure: Top tab bar (Fintech & Banking, Healthcare & HIPAA, Enterprise SaaS, AI & Data). Selecting a tab reveals an industry hero card with sector-specific architecture, compliance badges, and case study link.
archetypes.typography_specs: Tab label: text-sm font-semibold. Sector title: text-2xl font-bold. Compliance pill: text-xs font-mono.
archetypes.key_components: Segmented tab bar, industry solution card, compliance badge strip, featured client quote.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Tabs convert to horizontal swipe list on mobile with snap-x scrolling.
archetypes.accessibility: role='tablist' with aria-selected states and arrow key navigation.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Industry sections must address real regulatory requirements (e.g. HIPAA, PCI-DSS Level 1), not generic copy.

archetypes.name: Role / Persona Solution Cards
archetypes.best_for: B2B enterprise platforms selling to multiple internal stakeholders with different purchasing criteria.
archetypes.layout_structure: 3-column card grid: 'For Technical Leaders (CTO/VP Eng)', 'For Product & Growth Leaders (CPO/VP Growth)', 'For Financial & Executive Leaders (CEO/CFO)'.
archetypes.typography_specs: Persona title: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)]. Headline: text-lg font-bold. Value bullet: text-sm.
archetypes.key_components: Stakeholder icon, core outcome headline, 3 concrete value metrics (e.g. '50% less tech debt', '2x release velocity').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 3 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <article> per persona with clear H3 heading.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Speak directly to each stakeholder's concrete metrics; avoid universal vague platitudes.

archetypes.name: Split 2-Column High-Trust Intake
archetypes.best_for: B2B SaaS, enterprise consulting, and agencies seeking high conversion with minimal form friction.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column container (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16 items-start). Left (5 cols): Trust column ('What happens when you reach out', response time badge, enterprise client logo strip, VIP customer testimonial quote). Right (7 cols): Clean 5-field card form (Work Email, Full Name, Company Size dropdown, Project Scope, Submit button with micro-guarantee).
archetypes.typography_specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Form labels: text-xs font-semibold text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Inputs: text-sm py-2.5 px-3.5.
archetypes.key_components: Structured form card, work email domain validator, company size selector, trust bullets, response SLA badge ('We reply in < 2 hours'), submit button with loading spinner.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with headline and trust metrics above form card.
archetypes.accessibility: Inputs use explicit <label for='...'> tags, aria-required='true', aria-describedby for errors, focus-visible outline with 2px offset.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: STRICT: Maximum 5 fields; never ask for phone numbers on step 1 unless strictly requested. Zero generic captcha walls.

archetypes.name: Multi-Step Progressive Disclosure Wizard
archetypes.best_for: High-ticket services ($15k+) where qualified scoping is required before an executive consultation.
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered max-w-2xl mx-auto py-16. Top progress bar (Step 1: Your Goals -> Step 2: Timeline & Budget -> Step 3: Contact Details). Each step reveals 3-4 interactive pill buttons rather than text inputs.
archetypes.typography_specs: Step indicator: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)]. Step question: text-2xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Option pill: text-sm font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Progress step bar, selectable option pills with check indicators, animated slide/fade step transition (opacity duration-150), Back and Next buttons.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Full width pills on mobile with 48px tap targets.
archetypes.accessibility: role='form' with aria-live='polite' step announcements for screen readers; keyboard Arrow key navigation between options.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Never animate with jarring layout height jumps; step transitions use opacity only with fixed min-height container.

archetypes.name: Direct Embedded Meeting Scheduler
archetypes.best_for: Founder-led agencies and agile teams where booking a direct 30-min discovery call is the fastest path to closing.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column split. Left: Host profile (portrait photo, executive bio, meeting agenda, 'What to prepare'). Right: Embedded Cal.com / Calendly calendar widget with time zone detection and available slot picker.
archetypes.typography_specs: Host name: text-lg font-bold. Meeting title: text-xl font-bold. Agenda items: text-sm leading-relaxed.
archetypes.key_components: Host avatar (aspect-square rounded-2xl), agenda bullet list, responsive iframe container, direct calendar link fallback button.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks on mobile with host details above the calendar embed.
archetypes.accessibility: Iframe has descriptive title='Select a date and time for a 30-minute discovery consultation'; full keyboard trap avoidance.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Must include a direct external booking link below the embed in case user ad-blockers block third-party iframes.

archetypes.name: Multi-City Interactive Location Cards
archetypes.best_for: Companies with physical offices in multiple major metropolitan markets (e.g. SF, NYC, London, Tokyo).
archetypes.layout_structure: 3 or 4-column card grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-12). Each card features city photography thumbnail, local address, local time clock, and Google Maps directions link.
archetypes.typography_specs: City name: text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Local time: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--primary)]. Address: text-xs leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: City photo (rounded-xl object-cover), local time indicator, physical address, direct email link, external map pin icon.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column on mobile, 2 columns on tablet, 3-4 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Cards use semantic <article> with clear H3 city names; external map links include aria-label.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Use authentic city studio photos or clean architectural crops; no generic flag emojis.

archetypes.name: Global Stylized Vector Map with Office Pins
archetypes.best_for: Global enterprise platforms and multinational consultancies highlighting international coverage.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width dark container featuring high-contrast monochrome SVG world map. Interactive glowing pins over active regions. Clicking a pin reveals office contact details.
archetypes.typography_specs: Region title: text-sm font-bold. Pin popover text: text-xs font-mono.
archetypes.key_components: Monochrome SVG world map, pulse SVG pin markers, interactive popover cards, fallback accessible text list.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Map scrolls horizontally on mobile or displays a stacked city directory list underneath.
archetypes.accessibility: Visual map paired with accessible HTML directory list for screen readers.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Crisp vector SVG map with zero blurry raster image backgrounds.

archetypes.name: 3-Pillar Response & Support Commitment Strip
archetypes.best_for: Setting clear communication expectations and eliminating the fear that inquiries go into an unanswered black hole.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width subtle strip py-8 border-y border-[var(--border-subtle)] bg-[var(--surface-subtle)]. 3-column layout (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 text-center).
archetypes.typography_specs: Commitment title: text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Description: text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Clock SVG icon ('< 2-Hour Response Time'), Shield SVG icon ('Strict NDA & Security Privacy'), Chat SVG icon ('Direct Slack Channel for Enterprise').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with 16px gap.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <section> with aria-label='Our Communication Commitments'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Keep commitments realistic; specify business hours if 24/7 coverage is not actually supported.

archetypes.name: Dual-Track Sales vs Support Routing Banner
archetypes.best_for: Preventing customer support tickets from cluttering the sales inquiry pipeline.
archetypes.layout_structure: Split card container. Left half: 'Looking to hire us or buy? Stay on this page.' Right half: 'Already a customer? Visit our 24/7 Help Center or Submit a Ticket' with quick links.
archetypes.typography_specs: Headline: text-base font-semibold. Link: text-sm font-medium text-[var(--primary)] underline.
archetypes.key_components: Split container, support portal button, status page indicator ('All Systems Operational').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks into 2 separate cards on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Both links have descriptive text avoiding generic 'Click here'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Clean subtle borders; no screaming alert banners or bright yellow caution colors.

archetypes.name: Split Hero Transformation Spotlight
archetypes.best_for: Highlighting a major flagship client success story with undeniable ROI and visual polish.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-20 items-center). Left (6 cols): Client logo, category eyebrow chip, punchy outcome headline, 3-metric ROI badge strip (+340% Pipeline, 45ms P99 Latency, 6-Week Delivery), 'Read Full Story ->' primary CTA. Right (6 cols): High-res responsive device mockup frame (MacBook + iPhone) with subtle ambient glow.
archetypes.typography_specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Headline: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-[var(--text-primary)]. Stat numerals: text-2xl font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400.
archetypes.key_components: Client vector logo, metric pill badges, primary case study CTA button, multi-device mockup container with 1px border.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with headline and metrics above mockup.
archetypes.accessibility: Device mockup image has descriptive alt text describing the client application UI; CTA has clear destination aria-label.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Metrics must be qualified and defensible; zero generic round stats like '100% better'.

archetypes.name: Full-Bleed Cinematic Visual Hero
archetypes.best_for: High-craft digital product studios, branding agencies, and 3D visual production houses.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width container (aspect-[21/9] or min-h-[520px] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden relative mx-auto max-w-7xl my-8). Background: looping muted MP4 video reel or high-res photography. Foreground card (bottom-left): Client name, project scope, key quote, and 'Explore Project' button.
archetypes.typography_specs: Overlay title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-white. Scope chips: text-xs font-mono text-slate-300 bg-black/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded.
archetypes.key_components: HTML5 video element with playsinline and autoplay, gradient scrim mask, floating glassmorphism metadata card, play/pause toggle.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Video aspect ratio adjusts to aspect-video on mobile; card sits cleanly below or inside.
archetypes.accessibility: Includes visible play/pause button for WCAG 2.2 Pause/Stop/Hide rule; video is muted by default.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Must provide a fallback poster image for slow connections; video must be compressed under 4MB.

archetypes.name: Minimalist Power-Metric Header
archetypes.best_for: Enterprise engineering consultancies where cumulative track record outweighs single visual projects.
archetypes.layout_structure: Single column max-w-4xl mx-auto py-24 text-center. Giant editorial headline announcing cumulative scale (e.g. '$4.2B in client value shipped across 85+ production deployments'), followed by a 3-badge proof strip.
archetypes.typography_specs: Eyebrow: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--text-muted)]. H1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl font-serif font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-[1.12].
archetypes.key_components: Oversized typography headline, client logo row, category quick-jump anchors.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Fluid typography clamping preserving line breaks on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Headings follow strict hierarchy H1 -> H2; text contrast exceeds 7:1.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Zero cartoon emojis or floating sparkles; pure typographic authority.

archetypes.name: Multi-Pill Filterable Grid with Impact Badges
archetypes.best_for: Agencies and dev shops with 12 to 30+ varied case studies spanning multiple industries and tech stacks.
archetypes.layout_structure: Sticky filter pill header (All, Fintech, Healthtech, AI & Data, B2B SaaS). Below: 2 or 3-column responsive card grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8). Each card: high-res project image (aspect-[16/10]), client logo, deliverables tag, bold impact metric badge (e.g. '+240% ARR'), and case title.
archetypes.typography_specs: Filter pill: text-xs font-semibold px-3.5 py-1.5. Card title: text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Metric tag: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-emerald-400 bg-emerald-500/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full.
archetypes.key_components: Filter pill bar with active indicator, image card with hover zoom (scale-102 duration-200), client logo chip, impact metric pill, tag list.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Filter pills scroll horizontally with snap-x on mobile; grid collapses to single column.
archetypes.accessibility: Filter bar uses role='tablist' with aria-selected states; filter updates announce item count via aria-live='polite'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Zero slow animated reflows; filter uses fast CSS opacity/visibility transitions with zero layout shifts.

archetypes.name: Asymmetric Editorial Masonry with Embedded Quotes
archetypes.best_for: Award-winning creative design studios showcasing varied aspect ratios and typography.
archetypes.layout_structure: Asymmetric 2-column masonry grid. Standard project cards alternate with full-quote cards (large quote from client CEO) and video preview cards.
archetypes.typography_specs: Title: text-2xl font-bold font-serif. Tag: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--text-muted)]. Quote: text-lg italic.
archetypes.key_components: Asymmetric card heights, embedded client testimonial cards, hover video loops, clean link arrows.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Collapses to single column on mobile while maintaining quote cards between projects.
archetypes.accessibility: Quote cards use semantic <figure> and <blockquote>; images have rich descriptive alt text.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Ensure image cards maintain consistent contrast and alignment; avoid unreadable text over photos.

archetypes.name: High-Density Data-Dense Ledger
archetypes.best_for: Enterprise systems consultancies, cybersecurity firms, and technical architecture teams.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width searchable table with live search input. Columns: Client & Sector, Scope of Work, Primary Deliverable, Verified Impact Metric, Link / Case Study.
archetypes.typography_specs: Search input: text-sm font-medium. Table headers: text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[var(--text-muted)]. Rows: text-sm font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Live search filter, column sorting triggers, verified metric pills, PDF download / case link buttons.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Horizontal scroll container on mobile with sticky client column.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <table> with th scope='col', sortable buttons announce direction via aria-sort.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Crisp 1px borders; zero bloated decorative empty space.

archetypes.name: 3-Column Pull Quote Grid with Enterprise Headshots
archetypes.best_for: Reinforcing project outcomes with direct quotes from verified C-suite stakeholders.
archetypes.layout_structure: 3-column card grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16). Each card: verified client avatar, executive name and title, company logo chip, 3-sentence quote on tangible project impact.
archetypes.typography_specs: Quote text: text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-primary)]. Executive name: text-sm font-semibold. Title: text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)].
archetypes.key_components: Avatar photo (rounded-full 44x44), company logo SVG, quote block, LinkedIn profile link icon.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column on mobile, 3 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <figure> and <blockquote>; avatar has alt text.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Quotes must reference specific project results; no generic 'They were great to work with'.

archetypes.name: Full-Width Single Endorsement Banner
archetypes.best_for: Highlighting an exceptional marquee quote from a globally recognized Fortune 500 partner.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width elevated card (py-16 px-8 sm:px-16 rounded-3xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] text-center max-w-5xl mx-auto my-12).
archetypes.typography_specs: Quote: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-primary)]. Attribution: text-sm font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)].
archetypes.key_components: Marquee client logo, oversized quotation mark, executive signature or headshot, video interview trigger button.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Typography scales smoothly via fluid clamp; quote wraps cleanly.
archetypes.accessibility: Quote wrapped in semantic blockquote with cite attribute.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Clean monochromatic logo; no bright clashing client brand colors.

archetypes.name: Split Hero Lead Story
archetypes.best_for: Highlighting a major flagship thought-leadership essay, product announcement, or quarterly report.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column container (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-12 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16 items-center). Left (6 cols): Category chip, publish date, oversized editorial H1, 3-line excerpt, author metadata row (36x36 avatar, author name, estimated read time pill e.g. '8 min read'), 'Read Article ->' link button. Right (6 cols): Aspect-[16/10] editorial cover image with subtle 1px border and hover zoom.
archetypes.typography_specs: Category: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-[var(--primary)]. Title: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[var(--text-primary)]. Excerpt: text-base leading-relaxed text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Author: text-sm font-semibold.
archetypes.key_components: Category pill, editorial H1, excerpt, author avatar, reading time badge, high-res cover image.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with image above or below the headline.
archetypes.accessibility: Cover image has descriptive alt text summarizing visual; article link has explicit aria-label with full title.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No clickbait emoji titles or radioactive gradient badges; clean, authoritative editorial styling.

archetypes.name: Asymmetric 1+2 Editorial Trio
archetypes.best_for: Active publications and company blogs publishing 2-5 articles per week.
archetypes.layout_structure: Asymmetric 12-column grid. Left (7 cols): Large hero card with full cover image, category badge, and bold title. Right (5 cols): 2 stacked secondary trending cards with smaller horizontal thumbnails, titles, and read times.
archetypes.typography_specs: Hero title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold. Secondary title: text-lg font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Date: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
archetypes.key_components: Primary lead card, 2 secondary stacked cards, 'Trending Stories' header, category tags.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks into 3 sequential cards on mobile viewports.
archetypes.accessibility: Articles wrapped in semantic <article> tags with independent headings.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Ensure thumbnail crops maintain consistent aspect ratios; no distorted imagery.

archetypes.name: Minimalist Editorial Cover
archetypes.best_for: Deep research institutions, engineering engineering-heavy blogs, and intellectual essays without photographic assets.
archetypes.layout_structure: Single column max-w-3xl mx-auto py-24 text-center. Category eyebrow in monospace, giant serif title, 2-line thesis excerpt, followed by author bio pill and publication timestamp.
archetypes.typography_specs: Title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)] leading-[1.15]. Excerpt: text-lg text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Metadata: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)].
archetypes.key_components: Oversized serif typography, thesis callout, author signature, reading time estimate.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Fluid typography scaling for mobile screens maintaining comfortable line length (55-75 chars).
archetypes.accessibility: Meets WCAG 2.2 AA text contrast (min 7:1 for editorial typography).
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Zero floating badges or emoji decorations; pure typographic authority.

archetypes.name: 3-Column Responsive Article Card Grid
archetypes.best_for: Standard company blogs and knowledge bases with 15+ published articles across 4-6 topics.
archetypes.layout_structure: Sticky topic filter pill bar (All, Engineering, Product, Culture, Case Studies). Below: 3-column card grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-12). Each card: aspect-[16/10] cover, topic badge, publication date, H3 title, 2-line summary, and read-time pill.
archetypes.typography_specs: Filter pill: text-xs font-semibold px-3 py-1.5. Card title: text-lg font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Summary: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Topic filter pills with active state, article card with hover elevation, bookmark/save SVG button, pagination controls.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Filter pills scroll horizontally with snap-x on mobile; grid collapses to single column.
archetypes.accessibility: role='tablist' on topic filters; each article card is an <article> with semantic H3.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Fast client-side filtering with zero layout jump; no infinite scroll without footer access.

archetypes.name: Magazine Horizontal Article Strip List
archetypes.best_for: Publications focused on reading comfort and high-density browsing (similar to Medium or Substack).
archetypes.layout_structure: Stacked horizontal article rows (max-w-4xl mx-auto divide-y divide-[var(--border-subtle)] py-8). Each row: Left col: Author chip, publish date, bold title, excerpt, tags. Right col: Compact aspect-square thumbnail (96x96 or 120x120).
archetypes.typography_specs: Title: text-xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Excerpt: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)] line-clamp-2. Meta: text-xs font-mono.
archetypes.key_components: Horizontal card flex container, compact thumbnail, reading time pill, bookmark trigger.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Thumbnail moves to top or maintains compact 80x80 size on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Links contain descriptive title text; bookmark button has accessible aria-label.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No animated text truncation glitches; use clean CSS line-clamp-2.

archetypes.name: High-Density Chronological Index
archetypes.best_for: Developer documentation blogs, security changelogs, and research archives.
archetypes.layout_structure: Clean table or stacked list grouped by Year (e.g. '2026', '2025'). Each entry: Date in monospace on left, article title in center with hover underline, topic tag and read time on right.
archetypes.typography_specs: Year header: text-sm font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)]. Date: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]. Title: text-base font-medium.
archetypes.key_components: Year anchors, 3-column row, hover background tint, topic tag chips.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks date above title on mobile screens.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <ol> or <dl> with clear date-title association.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Zero unnecessary decorative graphics; maximum reading efficiency.

archetypes.name: Full-Width High-Contrast Knowledge Card
archetypes.best_for: Growing an organic email subscriber base of industry practitioners and executives.
archetypes.layout_structure: Elevated centered card (max-w-4xl mx-auto py-12 px-8 sm:px-12 rounded-3xl bg-[var(--surface-raised)] border border-[var(--border-subtle)] my-16 text-center). Headline, subscriber count proof ('Join 35,000+ engineers'), single-field email input with embedded submit button, zero-spam micro-guarantee.
archetypes.typography_specs: Title: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Subtitle: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)]. Input: text-sm py-2.5 px-4.
archetypes.key_components: Email input, submit action button with loading state, subscriber count chip, privacy guarantee text ('No spam. Unsubscribe anytime with 1 click').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Input and button stack vertically on mobile with full width.
archetypes.accessibility: Explicit <label for='newsletter-email'> (can be visually hidden), aria-required='true', aria-invalid error state messaging.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: No deceptive dark patterns ('No, I hate learning' cancel buttons); clean, dignified opt-in.

archetypes.name: Split Curated Digest Box with RSS Fallback
archetypes.best_for: Technical blogs catering to senior engineers and developers who value RSS and curated digests.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column split card. Left: 'The Weekly Dispatch' + bullet list of 3 recent exclusive deep dives sent to subscribers. Right: Email subscription form + direct RSS feed link button.
archetypes.typography_specs: Title: text-xl font-bold. Bullet items: text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-secondary)]. RSS link: text-xs font-mono text-[var(--primary)].
archetypes.key_components: Curated issue preview list, email form, RSS XML feed icon link, frequency note ('Every Tuesday at 9am EST').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile with preview list above form.
archetypes.accessibility: RSS link has aria-label='Subscribe via RSS XML feed (opens in reader)'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Specify exact sending frequency and topic scope so users know what they are subscribing to.

archetypes.name: 4-Column High-Trust Benefits Grid
archetypes.keywords: benefits, perks, compensation, equity, healthcare, time-off, careers
archetypes.best_for: Companies presenting structured benefits across compensation, health, workspace, and time off.
archetypes.layout_structure: 4-column grid (grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-14). Categorized cards: Compensation & Equity, Health & Family, Workspace Stipends, Time Off & Sabbaticals.
archetypes.typography_specs: Category header: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--primary)]. Benefit title: text-base font-bold. Detail: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: 24x24 precision SVG icon, categorized benefit heading, concrete numeric policy items, transparent footnote.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 4 columns desktop.
archetypes.accessibility: Each benefit card uses <article> with <h3> headings and explicit list markup <ul>.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Zero generic 'ping-pong and free snacks' clichés; publish actual numeric benefits and eligibility dates.

archetypes.name: Compensation Philosophy Manifesto
archetypes.best_for: Organizations differentiating on transparent salary formulas, geographic tiers, and annual equity refreshers.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column split (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-14). Left (5 cols): Compensation philosophy statement and pay equity pledge. Right (7 cols): Band formula breakdown table and level progression.
archetypes.typography_specs: Formula readout: text-lg font-mono font-semibold text-[var(--text-primary)]. Band row: text-sm tabular-nums.
archetypes.key_components: Salary formula equation block, level progression table, equity refresher schedule badge.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Stacks vertically on mobile; table scrolls horizontally with sticky role column.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <table> with <th scope='col'> and <th scope='row'>; high-contrast tabular numerals.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Never say 'competitive salary' without posting band ranges and leveling methodology.

archetypes.name: Remote-First Stipend Matrix
archetypes.best_for: Remote-first companies detailing home office setup budgets, learning stipends, and coworking allowances.
archetypes.layout_structure: 3-column card grid with bold annual stipend totals anchored at top of each card ($2,000 Home Office, $1,500 Learning, $350/mo Coworking).
archetypes.typography_specs: Stipend figure: text-3xl font-mono font-extrabold text-[var(--primary)] tabular-nums. Title: text-lg font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Monospaced dollar figure, reimbursement rule chip, eligible expenses list.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: 1 column mobile, 3 columns desktop with equal card height.
archetypes.accessibility: Figures paired with descriptive text labels; contrast >= 4.5:1 across light and dark modes.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: State exact annual vs. one-time cadence and approval constraints transparently.

archetypes.name: Parental & Wellness Commitment Banner
archetypes.best_for: People-first companies highlighting paid parental leave, mental health stipends, and company-wide recharge weeks.
archetypes.layout_structure: Full-width elevated card (max-w-5xl mx-auto rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-subtle)] p-8 sm:p-10) split into 3 horizontal pillars with subtle vertical dividers.
archetypes.typography_specs: Metric anchor: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold font-mono. Policy summary: text-sm text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: 16-week paid leave block, mental health coverage badge, annual company recharge calendar.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Dividers switch from vertical to horizontal on mobile stack.
archetypes.accessibility: Semantic <section> with aria-label='Parental Leave and Wellness Commitments'.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Avoid vague 'unlimited PTO' claims without stating minimum encouraged days off.

archetypes.name: Department Filterable Requisition Board
archetypes.best_for: Growing teams with 5+ open roles across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-To-Market.
archetypes.layout_structure: Sticky department tab bar (All, Engineering, Product, Design, Go-To-Market) above stacked full-width job rows showing role title, location/remote tag, salary range, and 'Apply ->' button.
archetypes.typography_specs: Role title: text-lg font-semibold. Metadata (Location, Salary Range): text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Accessible tab filter, live role counter, salary band badge, 44px Apply button, zero-roles fallback alert.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Filter pills scroll horizontally on mobile; job rows stack metadata cleanly under role title.
archetypes.accessibility: role='tablist' filter bar, aria-live='polite' result count, descriptive link labels ('Apply for Senior Frontend Engineer').
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Display location eligibility and salary band on every role row; zero 'rockstar/ninja' titles.

archetypes.name: Single Requisition Expandable Accordion
archetypes.best_for: Lean teams wanting candidates to inspect role mission, responsibilities, and apply inline without page hops.
archetypes.layout_structure: Centered max-w-4xl mx-auto py-12 space-y-3. Each accordion header shows title, team, and location; expanding reveals role mission, 3 core responsibilities, qualifications, and inline application form.
archetypes.typography_specs: Role trigger: text-lg font-semibold. Section label: text-xs font-mono uppercase.
archetypes.key_components: Accordion trigger with aria-expanded and aria-controls, structured bullet lists, inline CV/link upload form.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Full width on mobile with >= 44px touch targets and generous field spacing.
archetypes.accessibility: Keyboard Enter/Space toggle, explicit <label> on inline application fields, focus-visible dual ring.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Keep qualification bullets realistic (3-5 essentials); no 20-requirement wishlists.

archetypes.name: Interview Pipeline & Transparent Process Stepper
archetypes.best_for: Teams reducing candidate anxiety by documenting exact interview stages, durations, and decision timelines.
archetypes.layout_structure: 4-step horizontal stepper on desktop (grid-cols-4 gap-6) covering Recruiter Sync (30m), Technical Deep Dive (60m), Paid Work Sample or Pairing (2h), and Final Offer.
archetypes.typography_specs: Step badge: text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--primary)]. Duration chip: text-xs font-mono. Stage title: text-base font-bold.
archetypes.key_components: Sequential stage cards, time commitment badges, preparation guide note, candidate SLA ('Decision within 48h').
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Collapses to numbered vertical timeline on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Ordered list <ol> preserving chronological step sequence.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Never omit expected turnaround times or ask for unpaid multi-day take-home projects.

archetypes.name: Sticky Table of Contents & Prose Split
archetypes.keywords: legal, privacy-policy, terms-of-service, toc, gdpr, compliance
archetypes.best_for: Audit-grade Privacy Policies, Terms of Service, and Security Docs requiring scannable long-form legibility.
archetypes.layout_structure: 2-column container (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-10 max-w-6xl mx-auto py-16). Left (3 cols): Sticky scroll-spy Table of Contents tracking active anchor sections. Right (9 cols): Prose container constrained to max-w-prose (65ch) with generous vertical spacing.
archetypes.typography_specs: H1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight. Section H2: text-xl font-semibold mt-10 mb-3. Body: text-base leading-relaxed (1.65) text-[var(--text-secondary)].
archetypes.key_components: Sticky TOC nav with active anchor highlight, effective date stamp, plain-English callout boxes, anchored section headings.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Sticky sidebar collapses into a collapsible 'Jump to section' select/accordion above content on mobile.
archetypes.accessibility: Landmark <nav aria-label='Table of contents'> with aria-current='location' on active section and scroll-margin-top for sticky headers.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Never render unstyled 10,000-word walls of tiny gray text; enforce >= 4.5:1 contrast and 65ch max measure.

archetypes.name: Tabbed Policy Multi-Doc Hub
archetypes.keywords: policy-hub, terms, privacy, dpa, subprocessors, acceptable-use
archetypes.best_for: SaaS and enterprise platforms hosting Terms, Privacy Policy, Sub-processors List, AUP, and DPA in one hub.
archetypes.layout_structure: Top segmented tab navigation switching cleanly across Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Sub-processors, Acceptable Use, and DPA, paired with structured tables for sub-processors and retention schedules.
archetypes.typography_specs: Tab button: text-sm font-semibold min-h-[44px]. Table metadata: text-xs font-mono.
archetypes.key_components: Accessible policy tabs, sub-processor table (Vendor, Purpose, Region), contact DPO card.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Horizontal snap-scroll tab bar on mobile; sub-processor table wraps in horizontal scroll region.
archetypes.accessibility: role='tablist', role='tab', aria-selected, keyboard ArrowLeft/ArrowRight navigation, proper <table> headers.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Keep every policy URL deep-linkable via hash or query param so procurement teams can bookmark specific agreements.

archetypes.name: Versioned Compliance Header with PDF Download
archetypes.best_for: Regulated enterprise vendors maintaining version history, diff summaries, and downloadable signed PDFs.
archetypes.layout_structure: Top compliance utility bar (max-w-5xl mx-auto py-8 border-b border-[var(--border-subtle)]) with Last Updated timestamp, version selector dropdown (v2.4 Active / v2.3 Archived), Plain-English Summary toggle, and PDF download action.
archetypes.typography_specs: Version badge: text-xs font-mono font-semibold. Summary text: text-sm leading-relaxed.
archetypes.key_components: Version selector <select> with explicit <label>, plain-English summary panel, accessible PDF download link with file size.
archetypes.responsive_behavior: Utility controls wrap cleanly into a 2-row stack on mobile with >= 44px tap heights.
archetypes.accessibility: Download link announces file format and size; summary toggle uses aria-expanded and aria-controls.
archetypes.anti_slop_rules: Clearly distinguish archived versions with a high-contrast banner so users do not mistake superseded terms for current terms.
